To the people of Venezuela, our war is over. 
Now let us build this peace together.

Venezuelan people are not Pan-American or Pan-Bolivarian or Greater Colombian. 
You are Venezuelans, proudly, and you have been for centuries. 
And now is your time to boldly, as you have so many times in your past, reclaim it.
